name: DGL Group
summary: DGL Group Limited is an Australian-based company operating across Australia and New Zealand, specializing in a comprehensive suite of chemical and logistical services. Its operations are structured into three distinct divisions: Chemical Manufacturing, Warehousing and Distribution, and Environmental Solutions. The Chemical Manufacturing division focuses on creating a diverse range of specialized chemicals, offering advanced custom formulation and contract production services to external clients. This segment also markets water treatment chemicals under the Hardman brand. Through its Warehousing and Distribution segment, DGL provides extensive logistical support, including freight forwarding, inventory management, transportation, and storage facilities. While its primary expertise lies in handling dangerous and hazardous materials across Australia and New Zealand, the company also manages the distribution and logistics for a variety of other products, such as foodstuffs, pharmaceutical goods, agricultural supplies, security-sensitive items, and temperature-controlled products. The Environmental Solutions segment is dedicated to resource recovery and waste management. Its activities encompass the treatment of liquid waste, the recycling of used lead acid batteries, and lead smelting and refining processes. DGL serves a broad spectrum of industries, including agriculture, water treatment, mining, construction, automotive, food, pharmaceuticals, lead smelters, plastic recyclers, utilities, galvanizers, manufacturing, home and garden, and chemical companies. Incorporated in 1984, the company changed its name from DGL Environmental Pty Ltd to DGL Group Limited in April 2021 and maintains its headquarters in Melbourne, Australia.
